name: io.github.Hire-Overseas/hire-overseas-mcp
title: Hire Overseas
description: Find vetted remote talent in the Philippines, Latin America and Africa; pricing, résumés and intros.

tools.name: search_candidates
tools.description: Searches Hire Overseas's pool of remote professionals in the Philippines, Latin America and Africa for a role and returns up to 5 candidate profiles in seconds. Profile text is redacted and pseudonymous: first name, country, skills and experience; never a surname, contact detail or employer name. Each profile has a candidateRef that get_candidate_resume and request_intro accept, and says whether a resume exists. A profile can also have an intro video link, which is not redacted and may identify the person by face and voice. For closer matches pass the full job description (job_description or job_description_url) or a brief. When the role is described in only a few words the answer also carries clarifyingQuestions: ask the user them and search again with the answers.

description.description: What the person will do, tools they need, hours. More detail gives better matches.

minYearsExperience.description: Only return candidates with at least this many years of relevant experience, e.g. 3

regions.description: Limit to regions: ph (Philippines), latam (Latin America), africa. Omit for all.

job_description.description: The full job description as text, if the user has one (up to 20,000 characters).

job_description_url.description: An https link to the job description (a job post, PDF or Word file). Hire Overseas fetches and reads it.

brief.description: Structured requirements, e.g. from scope_role or the user's answers to clarifyingQuestions: {mustHaveSkills, niceToHaveSkills, minYearsExperience, regions, budgetMonthlyUsd, hoursPerWeek, timezone, industry}.

lead_token.description: leadToken from verify_email, if the user verified their email. Enables a closer reranking.

tools.name: scope_role
tools.description: Reads a job description (text or an https link) or a few sentences about a role and returns a structured brief (must-have and nice-to-have skills, years, regions, budget), the questions it leaves open, and a ballpark monthly cost. Ask the user the openQuestions, then pass the brief to search_candidates. The first call is free; after that it needs the user's verified email (lead_token from verify_email).

text.description: The job description or a description of the role, as text.

job_description_url.description: An https link to the job description (a job post, PDF or Word file).

lead_token.description: leadToken from verify_email. Needed after the first free call.

tools.name: get_candidate_resume
tools.description: Returns a candidate from search_candidates: the public profile (first name, country, headline, experience, skills, work history). With lead_token (from verify_email) it also returns the candidate's anonymized Hire Overseas résumé as text, with no surname, contact details, links, employer names, city or referees, and a link to the candidate page. Without lead_token, ask the user for their work email and call submit_email, then verify_email, then call this again with lead_token.

lead_token.description: Optional. The leadToken from verify_email, once the user has verified their work email. Unlocks the candidate's anonymized Hire Overseas résumé text and candidate page (branded résumé and intro video) and uses the verified email.

tools.name: salary_benchmark
tools.description: Returns a ballpark monthly range in USD for a full-time (or part-time) remote hire through Hire Overseas for a role, from the Hire Overseas rate card, adjusted by real placement data for the region when there is enough of it. A range for the role, not the price of any candidate. Hire Overseas works within the client's budget; the exact rate is confirmed on a short call (bookACall).

role.description: Job title or a few words about the role, e.g. 'Executive Assistant' or 'SDR for a SaaS startup'

seniority.description: Experience level: junior (about 0-2 years), mid (3-5) or senior (6+). Omit if unknown.

region.description: Where the hire would be based: ph (Philippines), latam (Latin America) or africa. Omit for any region.

hours.description: full_time (default, about 40 hours a week) or part_time

ai_heavy.description: true when the role needs strong AI / automation skills (e.g. building with Claude, n8n, Zapier) on top of the base role

tools.name: savings_estimate
tools.description: Compares the fully loaded yearly cost of a US hire (base salary × 1.3 for taxes, benefits and overhead) with the Hire Overseas ballpark for the same role, and returns the yearly savings range and percentage. Without a salary it uses a typical US salary for the role. A ballpark, not a quote: Hire Overseas works within the client's budget and confirms the exact rate on a short call (bookACall).

role.description: Job title or a few words about the role, e.g. 'Executive Assistant' or 'SDR for a SaaS startup'

us_salary_usd.description: Yearly US base salary the client would otherwise pay, in USD, e.g. 65000. Omit to use a typical US salary for the role.

region.description: Where the hire would be based: ph (Philippines), latam (Latin America) or africa. Omit for any region.

seniority.description: Experience level: junior (about 0-2 years), mid (3-5) or senior (6+). Omit if unknown.

tools.name: request_intro
tools.description: Requests an introduction to a candidate returned by search_candidates. The request goes to the Hire Overseas team, who verify the candidate, confirm availability and pricing, and reply to the contact email, usually within one business day. Requires the requester's real company name and work email. One request covers one candidate. The answer can include an intro video link, which may identify the person.

roleTitle.description: Job title the candidate is being considered for, e.g. 'Bookkeeper'

clientContact.description: The user's work email, where Hire Overseas replies

message.description: Optional note for the Hire Overseas team: start date, hours, budget or anything else about the role

lead_token.description: Optional. The leadToken from verify_email, once the user has verified their work email. Unlocks the candidate's anonymized Hire Overseas résumé text and candidate page (branded résumé and intro video) and uses the verified email.

tools.name: get_request_status
tools.description: Returns pending_review, approved or rejected for a request made with request_intro.

tools.name: submit_email
tools.description: Starts email verification so the user can see branded resumes and videos or request introductions. Hire Overseas emails a 6-digit code to the address; then ask the user in chat for the code and call verify_email. Use the user's own work email; personal addresses are accepted but flagged.

email.description: The user's work email, e.g. 'ana@northwind.co'. The code is sent here.

name.description: The user's name, if they gave it

company.description: The company the user is hiring for, if they gave it

tools.name: verify_email
tools.description: Checks the 6-digit code the user received after submit_email. On success returns a leadToken: pass it as lead_token to Hire Overseas tools that ask for it for the rest of the conversation. Codes expire after 10 minutes and allow 5 attempts.

email.description: The same email given to submit_email

code.description: The 6-digit code from the email, as the user typed it, e.g. '482913'

tools.name: create_shortlist
tools.description: Saves up to 12 candidates from search_candidates as a private Hire Overseas shortlist page and returns its link (shortlistUrl) for the user to share with colleagues. Each person who opens it confirms their own work email first. Every candidate is checked again now; ones no longer available are left out and counted in droppedCount. The link works for 60 days. Requires the user's lead_token.

lead_token.description: The leadToken from verify_email. Required: shortlists and saved searches belong to the user's verified work email.

title.description: What the list is for, e.g. 'Bookkeeper shortlist for the finance team'

candidate_refs.description: candidateRef values from search_candidates, in the order to show them

note.description: Optional short note shown on the page, e.g. what the user liked about them

tools.name: save_search
tools.description: Saves a candidate search for the verified user. Every Monday Hire Overseas runs it again and, when there are new candidates, emails the user up to 5 of them (with a one-click unsubscribe). Takes the same search arguments as search_candidates plus a title. At most 5 saved searches per email. Requires lead_token.

lead_token.description: The leadToken from verify_email. Required: shortlists and saved searches belong to the user's verified work email.

title.description: A name for the alert, e.g. 'Senior bookkeepers, Xero'

description.description: What the person will do, tools they need, hours. More detail gives better matches.

minYearsExperience.description: Only return candidates with at least this many years of relevant experience, e.g. 3

regions.description: Limit to regions: ph (Philippines), latam (Latin America), africa. Omit for all.

job_description.description: The full job description as text, if the user has one (up to 20,000 characters).

job_description_url.description: An https link to the job description (a job post, PDF or Word file). Hire Overseas fetches and reads it.

brief.description: Structured requirements, e.g. from scope_role or the user's answers to clarifyingQuestions: {mustHaveSkills, niceToHaveSkills, minYearsExperience, regions, budgetMonthlyUsd, hoursPerWeek, timezone, industry}.

tools.name: list_saved_searches
tools.description: Lists the saved searches (weekly candidate emails) for the verified user, with their ids. Requires lead_token.

lead_token.description: The leadToken from verify_email. Required: shortlists and saved searches belong to the user's verified work email.

tools.name: delete_saved_search
tools.description: Deletes one of the verified user's saved searches, which stops its weekly email. Requires lead_token.

lead_token.description: The leadToken from verify_email. Required: shortlists and saved searches belong to the user's verified work email.

id.description: The id from save_search or list_saved_searches

tools.name: get_booking_slots
tools.description: Returns up to 8 open times in the next 7 days for a free strategy call with the Hire Overseas team, each with a booking link, plus a general booking link. With lead_token the links are prefilled with the user's verified name and email. Show the times in the user's timezone and let them pick; booking happens on the Calendly page the link opens.

lead_token.description: Optional. The leadToken from verify_email, once the user has verified their work email. Unlocks the candidate's anonymized Hire Overseas résumé text and candidate page (branded résumé and intro video) and uses the verified email.

timezone.description: The user's IANA timezone for the time labels, e.g. 'America/New_York'. Defaults to UTC.
